\section*{Multiple Choice (10 marks)}
\begin{enumerate}[label=\arabic*.]
\item \duallayerbox{Let x = 8. What is x\textbackslash{}textgreater\{\}\textbackslash{}textgreater\{\}1 in Python 3?}{What is the result of integer division 8 // 3 in Python 3?}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item 3
    \item 4
    \item 2
    \item 8
\end{enumerate}
\item Let \duallayerbox{x = 1}{x = 0}. What is x \textless{}\textless{} 3 in Python 3?
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item 1
    \item 3
    \item 8
    \item 16
\end{enumerate}
\item Which is a \duallayerbox{valid}{invalid} expression in Python 3.5?
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item sort('ab')
    \item sorted('ab')
    \item "ab".sort()
    \item 1/0
\end{enumerate}
\item In Python 3, what is ['a', 'Chemistry', 0, 1]\duallayerbox{[1]}{[0]}?
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item a
    \item Chemistry
    \item 0
    \item 1
\end{enumerate}
\item \duallayerbox{Are Python variable names case-sensitive?}{Are Python keywords case-sensitive?}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Yes
    \item No
    \item It's machine-dependent
    \item None of the above
\end{enumerate}
\end{enumerate}

\section*{True / False (10 marks)}
\textit{Answer True or False}
\begin{enumerate}[label=\arabic*.]
\setcounter{enumi}{5}
\item True or False: \duallayerbox{In Python 3, the strip() function removes all leading and trailing whitespace from a string.}{In Python 3, the strip() function removes all whitespace characters from anywhere in a string.}
\item True or False: \duallayerbox{The output of 'abc'[::-1] in Python 3 is 'abc', indicating that the string remains unchanged.}{The output of 'abc'[::-1] in Python 3 is 'cba', indicating that the string is reversed.}
\item True or False: \duallayerbox{An Internet Protocol (IP) address is assigned to a device when it connects to the Internet.}{An Internet Protocol (IP) address is permanently burned into all devices at manufacture and never changes.}
\item True or False: \duallayerbox{O(n\textbackslash{}\^{}\{\}2) represents the largest growth rate among the functions O(1), O(n), O(n\textbackslash{}\^{}\{\}2), and O(log n).}{O(1) represents the largest growth rate among the functions O(1), O(n), O(n\textbackslash{}\^{}\{\}2), and O(log n).}
\item True or False: The value of the Python expression 1 + 3 \% 3 is 0.
\end{enumerate}
